title: Strategic Signal Dossier and Priority Commitment Plan
creator: Asha Patel
description: Background: Ahead of the Q2 leadership forum we need a concise, decision-focused dossier that synthesizes product and usage signals across the platform and converts them into 2–3 prioritized investment asks with clear success criteria. Purpose: provide leadership a short package (<=10 slides + appendix) that surfaces directional tradeoffs (latency vs. cost vs. reliability), demand signals, and runway/commitment requirements for Dedicated and Private offerings. Scope: synthesize telemetry (latency/cost trends, anomaly bursts), ops incidents, sales pipeline signals, and developer adoption metrics; produce prioritized asks with rollout windows, estimated budget/ops effort, and fallback mitigations. Out of scope: deep technical implementation plans for kernel-level optimizations (will link ENG RFCs).
acceptance_criteria: Single PDF/Dek with a 1-page executive summary + 3 prioritized investment asks
Clear ask for each investment: ask amount (headcount or $), timeline, primary owner, and exit criteria
Concise appendix with 2 quarters of telemetry charts and 3 representative incident excerpts
Leadership can indicate commit/no-commit for each ask within the forum using the provided decision checklist
tasks: Data synthesis: pull latency/cost/usage signals (owner: Liu Zhang, due: 2026-03-09)
Commercial lens: summarize pipeline and logo-level asks (owner: Marisol Gomez, due: 2026-03-10)
Draft deck: 8–10 slides, exec summary, asks, risks (owner: Ben Carver, due: 2026-03-12)
Ops appendix: incident 72h timelines, postmortem excerpts (owner: Ethan Brooks, due: 2026-03-11)
Leadership review and redlines: collect comments and finalize (owner: Asha Patel, due: 2026-03-17)
Publish packet and run pre-brief with CFO/CTO (owner: Ben Carver, due: 2026-03-19)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Telemetry noise could bias prioritization. Mitigation: apply rolling-median smoothing and annotate confidence bands in appendix.
Risk: Asks require cross-org headcount. Mitigation: propose phased commit and fallback scope reductions for initial sprint window.
Risk: Leadership may request more technical depth. Mitigation: include one-page tech appendix and links to ENG RFCs for follow-up.
Risk: Sales pipeline estimates uncertain. Mitigation: include conservative and upside scenarios and signal sensitivity table.
metrics_and_signals: Primary metric: 95th p99 request latency trend (30d vs baseline)
Cost signal: USD per 1M tokens served by model family for hosted vs dedicated (rolling 7d)
Adoption: new developer signups with first successful inference in 14 days
Reliability: SEV2/SEV3 incident rate and mean time to recovery (MTTR) by service tier
Commercial: number of pipeline opportunities with committed POC for Dedicated/Private
deliverables: Decision checklist: binary commit table for leadership
One-page implementation intent for each ask (owners and rough estimate)
